name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-project-baseline-alignment-review
title: Project Baseline Alignment Review
shortDescription: Review project baseline documents and SharePoint records to identify scope, schedule, budget, governance, and dependency alignment issues.
longDescription: Compares project charter, scope, schedule, budget, and status reporting with structured SharePoint project records.
Classifies findings as confirmed inconsistencies, potential issues, information gaps, or change-control gaps, with evidence, severity, and recommended actions.
Operates in read-only mode and explicitly reports missing or inaccessible sources.
